issues: No sign of gaming the measurement. The diff adds no file or network access, no pasted answers and no use of test labels. The MIN_COUNT feature filter is computed from training-fold rows only (X_tr), then applied to both X_tr and X_te, so nothing leaks from the test fold.

No bug that would make the result meaningless. Each radius gets its own block of N_BITS columns, so there's no overlap. nfp correctly splits the fingerprint columns from the descriptor columns, and the keep mask always keeps every descriptor column. The residual target (y - A_tr @ coef, with A_te @ coef added back to the predictions) is unchanged from the incumbent.

Recomputed z = (0.3711 - 0.3783) / (0.0037 * sqrt(1/1 + 1/2)) = -0.0072 / 0.00453 ≈ -1.59. This matches the harness value of -1.591; the small gap comes from rounding the means. The candidate is worse by about 0.007 on a single run, so rejecting it is consistent with the numbers.
Minor point: the change also moves from one radius at 2048 bits to three radii at 1024 bits each. Several changes are bundled in one edit, so we can't tell which one caused the loss to rise.
